name: Less Grind Hits - fewer swings, faster tree fall
author: Anders
description: Fewer swings for pickaxe, axe and scythe. Pickaxe: nothing above 6 swings, plain stone in 1, better pickaxes help in proportion to tier. Axe: nothing above 4. Scythe: nothing above 2. For axe and scythe every tier above the minimum halves the swings. Minimum tool tiers are unchanged. Felled trees fall in about 1 second instead of 2.2, and you can walk away while they fall. Also makes the game use the best axe you carry. Edit the CONFIG block in js/plugins/LessGrindHits.js.
